message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 24 oz (680 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | To taste |
| | Italian seasoning or dried basil & oregano | 1 tsp each |
| | Red wine (optional) | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | 1 Tbsp chopped |
| **Ricotta Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Salt, pepper | To taste |
| | Nutmeg (optional) | Pinch |
| **Bechamel (White Sauce)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Salt, pepper | To taste |
| | Nutmeg | Pinch |
| **Cheese Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½–1 cup |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, sautéed & drained) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms (sautéed) | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper (diced) | 1 cup |
| | Carrot (grated) | ½ cup |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the pasta** if using regular sheets—boil until al dente, drain, and set aside.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, season, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare ricotta mixture**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
4. **Whisk the bechamel**: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk, season, and cook until thickened.
5. **Layer**: start with a thin layer of meat sauce, then pasta sheets, ricotta mixture, bechamel, mozzarella, and repeat. Finish with mozzarella and Parmesan on top.
6. **Bake** at 375 °F (190 °C) for 45–55 min, covered with foil for the first 30 min, then uncovered to brown the top.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
